# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security updates are only supported in the latest version (2.x.x at this time).
It is recommended to keep your dependencies updated regularly.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 2.x.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 2.0.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please create a GitHub Issue to report a vulnerability.
I will try my best to support in that case.
